newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares slip off record high in active day.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares slip off record high in active day.

text.p: Sweden's bourse was steady on Tuesday as the market took a breather after closing at an all-time high on Monday.
The market started the day a touch higher but weakened around lunchtime and stayed at these levels when Wall Street opened with slight losses during afternoon trade.
The general index dipped 0.03 percent to 2,016.25 after a fairly active day's trade with turnover of 4.2 billion crowns.
Brokers said telecoms major Ericsson slipped a little after strong gains on Monday. The stock closed 2.50 crowns lower at 160.50 crowns.
"Ericsson's developments during the night will be like a thermometer for tomorrow's trade in Stockholm," a broker said.
Other brokers said fundamentals still seemed good and there was room for further gains this week.
The drugs sector posted slight gains with the index rising 0.41 percent. Heavyweight Astra was one crown higher at 280.50.

Development company Sintercast, whose share price has plummeted due to its weighting in one of the Morgan Grenfell funds under investigation, took back losses. Its A share rose five to 210 and the B share 42 crowns to 220 crowns.
